```{python}
import pandas as pd
import altair as alt

# import the data
bangladesh = pd.read_excel("bangladesh_sea_level.xlsx", sheet_name="Observations")
maldives = pd.read_excel("maldives_sea_level.xlsx", sheet_name="Observations")
philippines = pd.read_excel("philippines_sea_level.xlsx", sheet_name="Observations")
all_countries = pd.read_excel("sealevel_global_explorer_data_global.xlsx", sheet_name="Observations")

# add country column to data
bangladesh['Country'] = 'Bangladesh'
maldives['Country'] = 'Maldives'
philippines['Country'] = 'Philippines'
all_countries['Country'] = 'Global'

# create a list to hold data from all three countries
data = []


for df in [bangladesh, maldives, philippines, all_countries]:
    recon_df = df[['Reconstruction Year', 'Reconstruction Obs', 'Country']].copy()
    recon_df.rename(columns={'Reconstruction Year': 'Year', 'Reconstruction Obs': 'Sea Level (mm)'}, inplace=True)
    recon_df['Metric'] = 'Reconstruction Obs'
    data.append(recon_df)

    sat_df = df[['Satellite Altimetry Year', 'Satellite Altimetry', 'Country']].copy()
    sat_df.rename(columns={'Satellite Altimetry Year': 'Year', 'Satellite Altimetry': 'Sea Level (mm)'}, inplace=True)
    sat_df['Metric'] = 'Satellite Altimetry'
    data.append(sat_df)


# combine the dfs into a single df
combined_df = pd.concat(data, ignore_index=True)

# drop years with missing data
combined_df.dropna(subset=['Sea Level (mm)', 'Year'], inplace=True)

countries = combined_df['Country'].unique()
metrics = combined_df['Metric'].unique()

# create selection points
country_select = alt.selection_point(
    name='Country', 
    fields=['Country'],
    bind=alt.binding_radio(options=countries, name='Country: '),
    value=countries[0]
)

metric_select = alt.selection_point(
    name='Metric',
    fields=['Metric'], 
    bind=alt.binding_radio(options=metrics, name='Sea Level Metric: '), 
    value=metrics[0] 
)


base = alt.Chart(combined_df).encode(
    x=alt.X('Year:Q', axis=alt.Axis(title='Year', format='d')),
    y=alt.Y('Sea Level (mm):Q', axis=alt.Axis(title='Sea Level Change (mm)')),
    tooltip=['Country', 'Metric', 'Year', alt.Tooltip('Sea Level (mm)', format='.2f')] 
)


line = base.mark_line(point=True).encode(
).properties(
    title='Sea Level Change Over Time In Selected Countries'
)

chart = line.add_params(
    country_select,
    metric_select
).transform_filter(
    country_select
).transform_filter(
    metric_select
).interactive()

chart.save("sea_level_plot.html")
chart.display()
```
